subject: Marketplace seller onboarding — Helios Retail (PO path & vendor forms)
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <procure@helios-retail.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace seller onboarding — Helios Retail

Hi Tessa / Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Helios Retail is ready to start listing on cloud marketplaces (AWS first, then GCP/Azure). Procurement asked me to share a few constraints so we can map the PO / billing path:

- Our legal entity: Helios Retail, Inc. (US TAX ID on file)
- We need to understand typical PO routing for marketplace entries (who signs, where the PO should be sent, and any purchase order templates you prefer)
- We have a preferred billing cadence (net-30) and require invoice-level line items: SKU, unit price, and marketplace fees separated
- Any vendor onboarding forms (W-9, bank details, company profile) you need up front

Can you send a short checklist and the standard forms so procurement can review? We’re aiming to complete onboarding in the first half of July.

If useful, looping in our partner NimbleCloud who is helping with integration: onboard@nimblecloud.com.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Head of Procurement, Helios Retail
[Attachment: vendor_summary.csv]

From: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <procure@helios-retail.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller onboarding — Helios Retail

Hi Maria — welcome, and thanks for the clear list. I’ve attached our onboarding packet and a PO template (see attachments). Quick notes and the recommended minimal path to get you live on AWS Marketplace:

1) Paperwork we need up-front (we included templates in the packet):
   - Completed W-9 or equivalent tax form (US sellers) [Attachment: Tax_W9_Helios_2025.pdf]
   - Signed vendor onboarding form (company address, billing contact, legal entity)
   - Bank wiring instructions / ACH setup for payouts (if you plan to accept marketplace payouts)

2) PO / billing flow options (short):
   - Standard: Helios issues a PO to Redwood (PO attached). Redwood invoices monthly; marketplace takes commission on payout reconciliation.
   - Marketplace-billed: Helios purchases through AWS Marketplace; AWS invoices Helios and remits to Redwood. In this case, we need to publish the correct SKU mapping and set billing metadata.

3) Timeline and owner suggestions:
   - Day 0–3: Helios returns completed W-9 + signed onboarding form
   - Day 3–7: Redwood sets up SKU & test listing with NimbleCloud (integration partner)
   - Day 7–14: PO routing confirmed and first invoice cycle scheduled

I’ve cc’d Ben from FinOps for the PO/payments details and Vanessa for marketplace activation steps and exceptions. If you can return the completed packet and the PO template filled, we’ll queue the AWS listing work and loop AWS Marketplace team if needed.

Attachments: Helios_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf; PO_Template_HEL-001.xlsx

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Programs / Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: Helios_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, Maria Gomez <procure@helios-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller onboarding — Helios Retail

Thanks Tessa — a couple of procurement/finance clarifications from our side (cc: Ben for accounting):

- Please confirm the billing entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices (legal name + billing address). Helios should return that on the onboarding form — we can’t process a PO without a firm billing entity.
- If Helios prefers direct PO invoicing (Redwood invoiced), we’ll need the completed PO template plus vendor bank details for payment setup. I attached an updated PO template with our internal routing code in case you want to paste it back.
- For marketplace-billed flows (AWS invoices Helios), note that vendor revenue reconciliation happens on our payout side and can add an extra week to payment timing. If this is sensitive for Helios, the direct PO route is smoother.

Also: Maria, if Helios is VAT-registered in the EU and plans to list in EU regions later, please include EU VAT ID on the onboarding form so we can map tax treatment early.

Attached: PO_Template_HEL-001_updated_for_finance.xlsx

—Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_Template_HEL-001_updated_for_finance.xlsx]

On Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 11:17 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Maria — welcome, and thanks for the clear list. I’ve attached our onboarding packet and a PO template (see attachments). Quick notes and the recommended minimal path to get you live on AWS Marketplace:...

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <procure@helios-retail.com>, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, aws-marketplace@amazon.com, onboard@nimblecloud.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller onboarding — Helios Retail

Hi Maria — quick checklist to close the loop and get dev & listing teams moving: 

1) Helios to return today/tomorrow: signed onboarding packet + completed PO template + W-9 (or EU VAT if applicable).
2) We’ll create a working SKU draft and share a short test listing by EOD Friday. NimbleCloud will coordinate the API keys and test payloads.
3) If you choose direct PO (Redwood invoiced): send PO to finance@redwoodinference.com with the PO number in the subject. If you choose marketplace-billed: reply and we’ll capture the marketplace contract ID and route to AWS for listing activation.

Next steps I’ll perform as soon as packets are received:
- Confirm vendor bank for payouts (Ben)
- Wire up SKU metadata and set pricing band (Tessa)
- Kickoff listing validation with AWS (I’ll loop the AWS contact)

Maria, I’ve created a DocuSign envelope for the vendor onboarding form to speed signatures: https://docusign.com/r/AB12C34/helios-onboarding (see related link). Once signed, please upload the completed W-9 and PO template to the Drive folder and notify us.

We’re targeting initial listing + test purchase by the end of next week. If anything is urgent on the procurement side (PO number or billing constraints), reply with the PO number and we’ll prioritize payment routing.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference
[signature]
